name: FutaDomWorld
source:
Imagine a world where your landlord is a futa, your pharmacist is a futa, your teacher is a futa, your gym coach is a futa, your hairdresser is a futa...

As a male citizen of the Empire, you are oppressed and objectified at every turn. Your goal is to choose a futa mistress from among many, and seduce them… before someone else decides you might be better as their bimbo slave. To do so, you'll have to study up, get toned at the gym, dress well, work, earn money, develop your sexual skills, and, of course, actually talk to your futa crush.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/FutadomWorld_Game]Patreon[/url]]
